brief: The viewer observes an impossibly complex, magnified cross-section of a mechanical device. The scene focuses on densely packed brass clockwork, featuring intricate gears and interlocking cams. Against this metallic backdrop, layers of material, like settled geological strata, rise and cascade in counter-intuitive patterns. The movement is perpetually rhythmic and cyclical, driven solely by the mechanisms, creating a continuous, mesmerizing ballet of polished brass and strange, settled matter. The palette is restricted to deep golds, patinas of verdigris, and burnished metallic hues.
